expires_today.title: Tales From the Iron Kingdoms
expires_today.description: Step into a world forged in steam and iron and tempered by war
expires_today.long_description:
In Warmachine the earth shakes during fierce confrontations between six-ton constructs of iron and steel clash with the devastating force of a locomotive, towering warbeasts hurl themselves at their foes in a frenzy of claw and fang, and bold heroes set the battlefield ablaze with with a tempest of of arcane magic as they forge the fate of nations in the fires of destruction.

Immerse yourself in Warmachine lore with this bundle of novels and short story anthologies, set in iconic locations and telling the stories of heroes, villains, and some of the Iron Kingdoms' most pivotal events. Collect each volume of the Iron Kingdoms Excursions, Warcaster Chronicles, Warlock Sagas, and Called to Battle series and more as you learn the backstories of key characters like The Butcher of Khardov and encounter a wealth of different peoples and cultures.

Grab this 41-ebook bundle at the price of your choice, and support the Child's Play charity with your purchase!

Also returning by popular demand is a collection of 65 Iron Kingdoms RPG (IKRPG) items, including core and source books for the Full Metal Fantasy and 5e editions, GM toolkits, bestiary's, and maps, first presented in the March 2025 Iron Kingdoms Humble Bundle.

A world of adventure and full metal fantasy awaits in the Iron Kingdoms.

expires_tomorrow.title: The Best of C.J. Cherryh by Daw Books
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Traverse planets, galaxies, and whole universes of adventure and mystery in this bundle of award-winning author C.J. Cherryh’s best novels! Start with her Hugo Award-winning sci-fi novel Downbelow Station, set on a backwater planet and its space station caught in the middle of an intergalactic war! Dive into the author’s classic (and extensive) space opera series full of assassination, mystery, and interspecies intrigue with Foreigner 10th Anniversary Edition! Take her high fantasy classics for a spin with all four books of The Complete Morgaine, following a woman tasked with saving the very fabric of reality from an ancient network of portals! There’s so much more to explore in this bundle of 30+ sci-fi and fantasy ebooks from one of the greatest working authors of our time, so grab them now at the price of your choice and support BINC with your purchase!

expires_within_72h.title: Dying Earth RPG Collection
expires_within_72h.long_description: Enter a decadent world of wit and danger with The Dying Earth Roleplaying Game. Drawn from the classic tales of fantasy titan Jack Vance, prime inspiration for the settings, moods and spells of Dungeons & Dragons, and designed by roleplaying legend Robin D. Laws.  Explore a wondrous, exhausted world. Trade pleasantries with its ravenous and articulate creatures. Match wits with rogues, merchants and arch-magicians, and pray your tongue is the sharper.  The entire game line of rules, settings, maps and lore, yours for the merest pittance! Before the flickering sun winks out for good and takes this bundle with it.  And should prying fools dare question you, explain that your purchase is motivated not by greed for absurdly good and fleeting bargains, but by pure charitable feeling toward the World Wildlife Fund.

expires_within_72h.long_description: Comics need great writers, sure, but they’d be nothing without the talented artists who put their blood, sweat, and tears into bringing these stories to life on the page. Our latest bundle in partnership with Fantagraphics celebrates the iconic artists behind EC Comics’ greatest hits! See the world of Ray Bradbury’s short stories like never before in Home to Stay! The Complete Ray Bradbury EC Stories illustrated by the likes of Reed Crandall, Frank Frazetta, Al Williamson, Wallace Wood, and more! Dive into the work of your favorite artists in collections like Jack Kamen’s Kamen’s Kalamity, Harvey Kurtzman’s Man and Superman, Jack Davis’ ’Taint the Meat… It’s The Humanity!, and Reed Crandall’s The High Cost of Dying. Get 40 collections highlighting EC Comics’ greatest artists for the price of your choice, and support Freedom to Read Foundation with your purchase!
